authored_by: driver (opus) acting as single arbiter; input = prep-context.json + clarity/scout.md knowledge card
sizing_gate: pass — 4 source files + rebuilt assets, one concern (scope labelling on the admin org map). Under the 6-file / multiple-concerns split threshold.
design_note: All three surfaces need the SAME answer to 'what scope are these numbers?'. Deriving that three times is how the two surfaces drift apart — which is the bug class this ticket is about. So derive it ONCE as a getter on stores/map.js (which already owns drivers, driverPositions and followedDriverKitId) and have every surface read it. lib/adminScope.js deliberately stays dependency-light (its header says it exists to avoid a fetch.js <-> map-store cycle), so the getter goes in the store, not there.
tooltip_wording_decision: In admin mode the tile tooltips DROP the ownership clause entirely rather than swapping 'your kit' for 'all drivers'. Reason: 'all drivers' would be false whenever a subset is selected — re-creating this very bug one layer down. The pill directly above states WHOSE the numbers are; the tooltip only needs to say WHAT the metric is. This is a refinement within the approved 'fix the copy' decision (gate answer 3) and is flagged for sign-off at QA.

subtasks.title: Scope labelling across the admin org map (pill, tile copy, Live Hits header)
subtasks.approach: 1) stores/map.js: add a single `statsScope` getter returning {state:'aggregate'|'subset'|'followed', driverName, selectedCount, totalCount} derived from followedKitId/selectedKitIds (lib/adminScope.js) plus drivers/driverPositions. Move the existing followedDriverName resolution logic into it verbatim so the followed label is byte-identical to today's. 2) App.vue: replace the local followedDriverName computed with the getter and generalize the pill (App.vue:90-96) to render in all three admin states — crimson for 'followed' (unchanged text and style), neutral grey for 'aggregate' ('All Drivers') and 'subset' ('Showing N of M drivers'). 3) MapStatsBar.vue: branch the four tile `description` strings on mapStore.adminMode, dropping the 'your kit'/'you scanned' ownership clause in admin only. 4) DashboardOverlay.vue:85-88: rebuild the Live Hits description from the same getter so it names the followed driver while following and says org-wide only when genuinely unfiltered. 5) npm run build and commit public/build.

intended_diffs.resources/js/clarity-scout/stores/map.js: New getter `statsScope` near the existing followed-driver state (~1444-1465). Pure derivation, no new fetches, no store mutations.
intended_diffs.resources/js/clarity-scout/App.vue: followedDriverName computed (344-353) reduced to a passthrough of the getter or removed in favour of it; pill block (90-96) becomes a 3-state render. Existing crimson followed pill text and classes preserved exactly.
intended_diffs.resources/js/clarity-scout/components/Ma: The four `description` strings in the `stats` computed (170,180,187,198) become adminMode-branched. No structural change; driver strings byte-identical.
intended_diffs.resources/js/clarity-scout/components/Da: The binary ternary at 85-88 becomes a scope-aware string built from the getter.
intended_diffs.public/build: Regenerated by `npm run build`; tracked in this repo (15 files) so it must be committed or the fix never reaches the served app.

components/ProfilePanel.vue — ScoutHome.vue's panel computed resolves 'profile' only when !adminMode; unreachable for an admin.
components/FloatingStatCard.vue via DayOverlay/TripOverlay — auth.js forces tripsEnabled=false in adminMode; unreachable in Bird's Eye.
components/ScannerMap.vue heatmap legends — those layers are deliberately org-wide and excluded from the kit_ids auto-scope, so their org-wide language is accurate in every scope state.
components/DashboardOverlay.vue:246-247 ('For all drivers' layer-visibility toggle) — a static admin setting, not a stat aggregate; the phrase is accurate.
app/Http/Controllers/Api/ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController.php — aggregation confirmed correct and unchanged by all three prep candidates and the gate.

verification.automated: npm run build (proves the SPA compiles) + php artisan test --compact --filter=ClarityScoutBirdsEyeControllerTest (proves the untouched backend is still green). No JS/Vue test runner exists in this repo, so nothing pins the rendered label automatically.
